about: Names defined more than once in the core script (the census of docs/CRITIQUE.md P3, counted by tools/lint-stages.mjs). The count may only fall: tools/check.mjs fails when it rises. Lower it with node tools/lint-stages.mjs --write when a step removes a definition; never raise it without a line in docs/DECISIONS.md. X2 (D-056) set it: 364 before, 357 once the seven hot functions had one definition each (2,487 definitions before, 2,358 after). Since 2026-11-25 (master prompt 4.6, H-123) it also holds addStage, the A.addStage registrations of the default build, and patches, the feature patch files built by default: both may only fall.
